title: Chapter 207 Terrifying Sword Light
content:
Chapter 207 Terrifying Sword Light

The two of them trembled and turned around and looked back.

boom!

A violent space fluctuation rushed past the two of them.

Suddenly, the two of them turned around in the void like a top for several times before they could barely stop.

"Wuhu~ You two are here to see you in the Immortal Realm!!"

Lu Xue's cheering sounded from afar, and then became smaller and smaller.

Standing there, the two of them were confused.

"I, am I dreaming?"

"This is impossible. How could the Immortal Lord Realm have such speed?"

The two of them looked at Lu Xue and Ao Qing who had already left in disbelief, and their hearts were filled with waves.

It took a long time before the two of them reacted.

"Chasing!"

With a whoosh, the two of them rushed towards the direction of the fairyland again.

This time, the two of them used all their strength to rush on the road, and they no longer had the contempt they had at the beginning.

Unfortunately, the speed of the two of them is no longer as fast as that of Ao Qing, who has the blessing of treasures. Even if they use their strength to feed themselves, they still cannot match them.

But the two still did not give up.

Because Xiao Chen and the others knew clearly the key to victory.

That is who arrives at the fairyland first.

You should know that if you want to enter the Immortal Realm, you must at least have the strength of the Immortal Saint Realm.

Let’s look at Lu Xue and Ao Qing, one is an immortal king and the other is an immortal king.

Even if the two of them give them time, they probably won't be able to enter the fairyland.

Thinking of this, the two of them gradually calmed down from their shocked expressions.

"Hurry up, don't let Miss Lu wait too long."

Xiao Xuanmu smiled faintly.

Xiao Chen looked at the direction of the fairyland and felt a little uneasy.

"Probably not."

Xiao Chen said intimately and then continued to move forward.

At the same time, the junction of the Wood Fairy Realm and the Fairy Realm.

A huge hazy barrier blocked Ao Qing and Lu Xue.

"stop!"

Suddenly, Ao Qing hurriedly stopped in the void.

The entire void was shaken by the rear force.

"My master, why stop? Isn't this coming soon?"

Ao Qing said with confusion.

Lu Xue squinted her eyes at the barrier in front of her, "It seems that the Immortal Realm is not something you can enter just by wanting to."

Hearing this, Ao Qing said disdainfully: "Don't panic, please see if I smash it head-on!"

Immediately, Ao Qing rushed into him without waiting for Lu Xue to speak.

boom!

Suddenly, the entire barrier began to fluctuate slightly, but that was all.

"What! So hard!!"

Ao Qing looked at the intact barrier in front of him with disbelief, and even his body could not be broken.

"Okay, this thing is not simple. Our cultivation level is still too low now, so it's normal that it can't be opened."

At this time, Lu Xue said in a faint voice.

Upon hearing this, Ao Qinglian suddenly collapsed.

"What should I do now, then?"

If you want to win, you have to enter the fairyland first than the other party. If you can't get in now, when those two old guys catch up, they will lose.

Seeing Ao Qing a little anxious, Lu Xue smiled with a crooked mouth.

"Look at me."

I saw that Lu Xue took out a long sword directly.

It is the Xuanyuan Sword that Lu Xue, who was once inherited from the Human Emperor Palace in the Ten Thousand Spirit Realm.

At this moment, in Lu Xue's hands, the Xuanyuan Sword has been continuously advanced and has completely transformed into the level of an immortal weapon.

More importantly, the Xuanyuan Sword contains power that does not belong to the Xuanyuan Sword.

Lu Xue held the Xuanyuan Sword in her hand and her eyes closed slightly.

After a moment of silence, Lu Xue slashed out with a sudden sword.

"cut!"

laugh!

Suddenly, a sword sounded across the world, and a dazzling sword light flew out from the Xuanyuan Sword, and a destructive aura continued to gush out.

At this moment, the stable space in the fairy world was split open, and countless complex and mysterious laws surged freely.

And the sword light went straight towards the barrier.

Buzz —

The whole space seemed to be silent.

The next moment, a deafening roar sounded.

The sword light seemed to enter the uninhabited realm and flew directly in, and a ferocious sword mouth appeared on the barrier.

However, this is not over yet.

Click!

I saw countless cracks suddenly appeared in the barrier, and with the sword mouth as the center, it began to crack quickly towards the surroundings.

With the rumbling sound.

The entire barrier was directly broken.

At the same time, in the fairyland.

An unprecedented terrifying sword light suddenly surged into the fairyland from the boundary of the fairyland, and the space was destroyed wherever it passed.

"That's it?!"

Countless genius strong men in the Immortal Realm looked at the sword, but a hint of despair surged in their hearts.

What kind of strong man is this?

"Duan Hen, is it you?"

At this moment, a dull sound came from the depths of the void.

The next moment, a man holding a sword in a long robe appeared in the void, looking at the surging sword light with a serious expression.

"Don't talk nonsense, I can't bear this cause and effect."

The man holding a sword in the long robe said in a deep voice.

Obviously, he is the character called Duan Hen.

Seeing Duan Hen like this, several phantoms appeared around Duan Hen.

"People, please help me."

Duan Hen stared at the sword light for a moment, and finally accepted the reality that he could not stop.

Then, Duan Hen rushed towards the sword with a sword.

boom!

The aura of the mid-stage ninth level of the Immortal Emperor Realm surged out from Duan Hen's body.

In an instant, the entire void was filled with terrifying sword energy.

However, Duan Hen directly sprayed out a mouthful of blood the moment he touched the sword light.

Seeing this, the phantoms around him no longer hesitated.

Countless terrifying forces gathered towards Duan Hen.

Each aura is not lower than the ninth level of the Immortal Emperor Realm.

Finally, with the joint efforts of several top-level strong men in the fairy realm, this terrifying sword light was finally blocked.

The sword light dissipated, and Duan Hen looked at the end ahead with a pale face.

"Who did this?"

One of the phantoms said in a voice.

"That seems to be the direction of the Wood Fairy Realm."

"It's the Wood Fairy Realm again?"

"It seems that there is an amazing guy in the Wood Fairy World."

Several phantoms spoke and said something, and the atmosphere seemed extremely depressing.

They guessed that it was a warning from a strong man from the Wood Fairy World to them.

"What should we do?"

Everyone was silent.

Only Duan Hen was resting for a while, got up and slowly heading towards that direction.

At the border of the fairyland.

"Oh, it seems like I've used too much force."

Seeing this scene, Lu Xue scratched her head embarrassedly.

Ao Qing was excited and said, "Young master is awesome!"

In the distance, Xiao Chen and the others who had just arrived here looked at the scene in front of them in amazement.

Crazy, crazy.

This world is crazy.

That's the barrier of the fairyland.

It has been around for many years, but today it was actually broken by an immortal king.

And it was completely broken!

Since then, the entire Wood Fairy World has no longer had any restrictions on entering the fairyland.

No one knows what will happen in the future.

At this time, Lu Xue and Ao Qing had already stepped in and entered the fairyland directly.

"Yeah! I won."

"Oh? Master, aren't those two old men?"

At this time, Ao Qing suddenly noticed Xiao Chen and the others who were still shocked.

Hearing this, the two of them reacted.
